propositions: Detection channel (canary, ci, review-bot, agent, human-audit, user-report) must be captured at ticket creation via REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var or optional --detected-by flag, with env as default and flag override.
Normalization applies strip+lowercase; empty/whitespace-only values are treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum enforcement; creation never fails on invalid values.

The detected_by field is projected into compiled state present-only via process_create mirroring source_* blocks, and events lacking the field reduce byte-identically to pre-change state (additivity property).
detected_by is declared as an optional string field in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in the env-var documentation registry.
Jira inbound reconciler (apply_inbound_records.py) intentionally bypasses create_core and does not stamp detected_by, preserving human-authored ticket attribution.
